title: Witness and Inheritance
author: Ulyana Fairweather
blurb: Dominic Nystrom, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
